answers.core: Since this necessarily would be integrated with the physics engine, I don't think this can be done as  an add-on.
answers.workaround: No, at least not to my knowledge, my attempt at doing this manually [was a lot of code](https://gist.github.com/Garbaz/5c8b9a313617c2904aa8cac02db2b003), didn't work perfectly and required a bunch of assumptions about the RigidBody, essentially replicating internal physics code (poorly).
